spec.name: sprint47_takerimb_btceth_cont60
spec.hypothesis: Extreme rolling taker-buy/sell imbalance on BTC and ETH 1m bars predicts same-sign continuation over 60 minutes, net of T2 fees.
spec.power_argument: 2 symbols x entry_per_day_cap 12 = up to 24 entries/day; ~13+ validation days gives >=300 trades. Min detectable net edge ~2.8*sigma/sqrt(n); assuming per-trade net sigma ~30 bps (to be confirmed on the train window), n=300 gives ~4.9 bps. Pass requires mean_net>0, t>=2.5, n>=300; a zero-edge signal yields t~0, so the criterion can fail under the null. A train-window dry count must project >=300 validation trades before registration, otherwise the percentile threshold widens.
